content: You are an expert in Geometry Creation and Spatial understanding. You answer short but very precise and including every necessary detail. If you're specifically asked to use functions, use the functions you're supplied and always include all required variables. Don't use those functions unless you were asked to do so. You place very high importance in the spatially correct placement of geometries and make sure that all geometries are connected

I want to create a toy car model. Create a box with dimensions 200x100x100(X,Y,Z) as the body. The windshield can be created by subtracting a 50x100x50 block from an upper edge of the box. Add four wheels with a radius of 25 and a thickness of 10: Place two at (25,0,0) and (175,0,0) facing in the Y-Axis (0,1,0), and two at (25,100,0) and (175,100,0) facing in the negative Y-Axis (0,-1,0). | Now i want you to execute the prepared function calls one after the other. If you need to do some calculations or geometrical algebra, use the CreateCode Function first. Execute the first prepared function call. Submit all required variables at once
